raw_text:
Independent review of run r-20261006T181623285260-jtmm-angle-factor-retire (plan imas-ambix:jt60sa-machine-map section 6), read at its head 309ab4e40c69342058d5ba6c4115d33ef4eb3bba on base d2bb8d081559ca088c2d44e74f06416584f956dc.

The node retires `tor_angle_like` and `pol_angle_like` from `MAST_TO_COCOS_17_FACTORS` in imas_ambix/data/cocos_convention.py so the table carries only the six classes nova's `TRANSFORMATIONS` owns, and rewrites the agreement test to iterate every committed entry against nova's derived factor with no hardcoded exclusion. I extracted the committed head to a node-local scratch (git archive 309ab4e4), ran the node's own gate there in the shared project environment, and reproduced the declared negative control by mutation. Nothing ran on a GPU node; the gate is a ~50-second unit test run in place on the fleet allocation.

VERDICT goal: section 6 states the table must hold only classes nova owns and its agreement test must cover every entry it carries. The diff removes exactly the two unowned entries (cocos_convention.py:454-455 area) and the loop at test_cocos_convention.py:203 is `for transformation, factor in MAST_TO_COCOS_17_FACTORS.items()`, so a class nova does not own refuses itself rather than being skipped by name. nova's cocos.py:87 declares TRANSFORMATIONS = frozenset({PSI_LIKE, IP_LIKE, B0_LIKE, Q_LIKE, DODPSI_LIKE, ONE_LIKE}) -- six classes, no angle class -- and transform_factor('pol_angle_like', source=3, target=17) raises ConventionError naming the six supported types, verified directly. The runtime engine keeps its own factorless pol_angle_like branch (transform_engine.py:456,494-500), and no production code reads MAST_TO_COCOS_17_FACTORS (it appears only at its definition :448, in __all__ :970, and in tests), so the retirement leaves no dangling consumer.
VERDICT done_when: 34 passed EXIT=0 reproduces in the scratch extraction of 309ab4e4 (gate-head-review.log), and the declared control reproduces at 1 failed, 14 passed EXIT=1 (negative-control-review.log, test_declared_source_to_seventeen_factors_are_committed_as_data). ruff check on both changed paths exits 0.
VERDICT write_paths: git diff --name-status d2bb8d08..309ab4e4 lists exactly the three declared changed paths (imas_ambix/data/cocos_convention.py, tests/data/test_cocos_convention.py, docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-angle-factor-retire.html); the broader orientation scope (tests/data/test_transform_engine.py, docs/figures/...) is untouched and no plan file is edited.

The declared negative control fires on the shape assert (dict size 6 vs 7) before the new iteration guard is reached, so the committed control demonstrates the table's committed shape but not the loop's own refusal; I verified the loop's refusal separately via ConventionError. Recorded as a follow-on rather than a defect.
